evidence.citation: Miwa (2019), Trading hours extension and intraday price behavior
evidence.direct_market: OSE Nikkei 225 futures and TOPIX futures
evidence.direct_claim: Negative association between overnight return and subsequent morning intraday return; night-session return is also negatively associated with subsequent intraday return.

stage_a.rationale: Post-literature-sample holdout before JNU Micro launch.

data.cloud_output: Per-day non-reconstructive overnight/morning signal sufficient statistics only; no raw minute bars.

measurement.prior_regular_close: Close of the final source 1-minute bar before the previous trading day's historical OSE day-session close.
measurement.current_regular_open: Open of the first source 1-minute bar at the current trading day's historical OSE day-session open.
measurement.morning_window: First 120 elapsed active day-session minutes beginning at historical OSE day-session open.
measurement.morning_return: log(close of the 120th active minute bar / current_regular_open)
measurement.accuracy: Among days with nonzero overnight return and nonzero morning return, fraction signal sign equals morning-return sign.

bootstrap.method: iid resample trading days with replacement

stage_a_pass_rule: At least 1000 usable post-2015 Mini trading days.
stage_b_pass_rule: Stage A PASS is mandatory; otherwise Stage B statistical evaluation is prohibited.
At least 500 usable exact-JNU trading days.
Identical signal/window/data handling with no retuning.
diagnostics_non_promotional: Regression slope of morning return on overnight return.
Night-session-only return relation, using the historical night-session boundary.
Gross signal payoff before transaction costs.
forbidden: Use full-day/30m/60m morning horizons to rescue failure.
Add VIX, volume, RSI, MACD, BOJ-event, or volatility-state filters to rescue G1.
Use night-session-only result to rescue a failed primary overnight signal.
Use exact-JNU Stage B to rescue a failed Mini Stage A.
Claim tradable alpha before execution/cost/overfit/forward validation.

interpretation.pass: If Stage A and Stage B pass, promote to a directional information candidate only; then run downstream trading-rule/cost/overfit/forward stages.
interpretation.fail: Close current family. Reopen only with substantively new independent evidence, not horizon/filter/sign rescue.
